label: wage-probe4
_why: Verifies the redesign that moves the trajectory onto cheap lines. Two things: (1) the new WSTR line emits real values - it bundles six script values and two data functions, and one bad call voids the WHOLE line, which would silently cost Q2 its mid-date standard-of-living and Q3 its workforce ratio; (2) a MIDDLE dump really does emit WSTR/WC/SW and no per-pop lines, while the first and last emit everything. Generation was already checked; this checks the game agrees.
_cost: One control run, three dumps inside 14 in-game months. About two minutes.
